scope: Actual GuestEngine Promise settlement and SDK-root lifetime in Node with a trusted local Host
limits: Source thenable adoption uses a private ordinary native Promise. Host constructor/species errors become asynchronous rejection rather than synchronous engine.set failure.
A live pre-action entry failure is reported, retains deferred roots until terminal cleanup, and does not establish guest settlement.
Reentrant closure is logically immediate; SDK roots remain owned until the active entry unwinds. Repeated deferred disposal relies on the pinned SDK idempotence contract.

The fixtures inject controlled local host/SDK failures. They do not prove complete C3 mediation, GenericBrowser producer provenance, arbitrary native-object behavior, browser qualification or application compatibility.
